title: Worth the few extra dollars
text: Worth the few extra dollars. Excellent grater. Easy to clean, sharp, and secure handle. Dishwasher safe. On par with other OXO products, high quality.

description: This OXO Good Grips Etched Zester Grater makes easy work of grating and zesting hard cheese, citrus, ginger, chocolate, and more. Comfortable soft handle offers a secure, slip-free grip while its non-slip foot provides added control during use.
